answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed onboarding improvements broadly to increase time-to-value, adoption, and retention without sacrificing long-term qualified revenue. Do not respond to the competitor's price cut with broad discounting: the recovered 40% SMB discount increased acquisition and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, indicating poor sustainable value and renewal risk. Continue monitoring price-sensitive SMB churn and renewal outcomes while using onboarding improvements as the lower-risk response.
